source: Six learning exchanges recorded as one batch
summary: Built a why question with correct word order but accent/spelling corrections. Used porque for a reason, with hablar spelling corrected. Introduced para + infinitive from the learner's purpose, then correctly reused para and distinguished purpose from reason in two choice prompts.

observations.outcome: Correct question structure and separate por que; supplied accented qué, ñ and opening question mark. The preceding prompt reminded the learner of ¿Por qué...?.
Correct porque for a reason and queremos. Corrected habler to hablar and supplied ñ.

Comprender was supplied correctly by the learner. Corrected conversaciones and España, then introduced Quiero aprender español para comprender conversaciones en España and explained para + infinitive. No real-world travel circumstances are inferred.

observations.learnerText: Queremos aprender espanol Para comprender conversationes
observations.correctedText: Queremos aprender español para comprender conversaciones.
observations.outcome: Correctly used para + infinitive and plural queremos after a model. Supplied standard spelling and lowercase para.
Correctly chose para in Queremos probar la función ___ publicarla. English translation explicitly included in order to, so this is cued recognition, not independent recall.
Correctly chose porque in Queremos probarla ___ es importante, given the choice porque or para. Successful immediate distinction; delayed retention not assessed.

nextSteps: Use para versus porque in a self-created work sentence
Recall why-question spelling after a gap without repetitive accent drills
Revisit un poco de, hablo and pronoun placement after a gap
assessmentNote: Modelled production and immediate choices; no mastery claim or delayed retention test.
